important_note: HELD_PREV_MONTH persistence is expected because previous weights are an explicit optimizer input for turnover control. The more relevant old-name comparison is RETURNING_NOT_PREV_MONTH vs NEVER_HELD_BEFORE, because both start with previous weight zero.
interpretation: Near-zero candidate-rate and target-weight gaps at similar current score are evidence against an explicit old-name preference, but remain associative because current risk/covariance characteristics can differ. The V0.7 all-ones selection-rate output was non-informative and is explicitly retracted rather than treated as evidence.
